content.summary: Shares of local business platform Yelp (NYSE:YELP) jumped 8.8% in the afternoon session after Evercore ISI Group upgraded the stock to “Outperform” from “In Line” and raised its price target. The firm's analyst, Shweta Khajuria, increased the price target on Yelp's shares to $45.00 from a previous target of $37.00. This new target represented a potential 21.62% upside from its prior level. The upgrade and higher price target indicated a more positive outlook on the company's future performance.
